files.change: 100-row bounded conditional DELETE within Store write transaction; expiry validation after acquiring send writer and after download authorization/scan checks
Existing minute maintenance calls attachment sweep; existing worker lifecycle and sweep return contract retained
Message-only Simplified/Traditional Chinese and English expiry sentence
New untracked file, 10 real-Store cases including deterministic writer ordering and actual worker lifecycle

root_causes: Sweep was never called by a worker
Candidate IDs were read before acquiring a writer and later deleted unconditionally, allowing deletion of concurrently bound attachments
Send/download did not enforce existing unsent expiry

policy.expiry: Existing 3600-second upload deadline; expires_at <= current time expires only unbound attachments
policy.before_cleanup: Authorized uploader receives HTTP 410 attachment_expired and re-upload instruction for send/download/inline
policy.after_cleanup: Missing attachment keeps existing HTTP 404 no_attachment behavior; no tombstones
policy.sent: Sent attachments and successful client_id replay are unaffected even if a historical bound row has stale expires_at
policy.authorization_and_scan: Authorization and quarantine refusal precedence preserved
policy.cleanup: At most 100 expired unbound rows per existing minute sweep; NULL deadline retained; no blob deletion
policy.scan_cost: Deletion batch is bounded; no new expiry index or schema migration, so row scanning is not guaranteed bounded

red.note: Pre-fix product implementation. Final worker test additionally checks recurring idle maintenance after first startup cleanup.

green_initial.note: All 10 D18 tests, 3 existing worker tests and attachment API test passed; 3 scanner fixtures could not bind 127.0.0.1 under sandbox.

scanner_retry.note: Only the three setup-blocked tests rerun with local socket permission. Local ClamdDouble fixtures, no production.

tests.warning: Existing Starlette TestClient anyio BlockingPortal deprecation

remaining: Independent review and any eventual commit/deployment are intentionally deferred until user resumes; none performed
exclusions: No identity, Docs, migration, shared locale, state document changes by this task
Other coordinator's pre-existing dirty files left intact

worker_lifecycle_assertions: actual start_jobs=True bridge thread not alive after TestClient lifespan
global bridge wakers restored to baseline
wake after stop does not delete newly expired fixture row
worker_cleanup.fixture_cleanup: autouse workers.stop_all(wait=3.0) after each Message test
worker_cleanup.process_check: read-only ps filtered to this D18 pytest invocation; no unrelated process details retained
